records.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: original fictional architectural reference photograph for an exact 3D building study, landscape 3:2. Warm muted sage horizontal clapboard with ivory window trim, a simple warm grey asphalt gable roof with ridge running left-to-right, total height about 4.5m including 0.45m raised floor. An integral-looking but separately supported full-width front timber porch 1.5m deep with a low lean-to metal roof under the main eave, four square painted timber posts on solid feet. Clearly visible five-part FRONT opening sequence from left to right: paired living room window, smaller kitchen window, single front door at exact centre, paired bedroom window, smaller bedroom window. Porch central three-step stair aligns with the one front door; open porch sides, no railings because low deck. Physically buildable, modestly detailed, charming well-proportioned affordable Canadian home, no luxury decoration. Photograph from a slightly elevated near-frontal viewpoint showing the full front and a small amount of RIGHT short end. Short right end has one centered window. Neutral early autumn daylight, plain pale gravel around home, no foreground plants obscuring structure. All building, skirt, roof and porch must be fully in frame with generous margins. Real timber and painted clapboard textures, crisp readable roof geometry. No people, cars, text, watermark or neighbouring buildings. Exactly one home, one storey, one long gable, one continuous shallow porch roof; no dormers, no wheels, no extra wings.
